Here are the main Japan stories from mid-October 2026, based on the latest coverage I found:

**Politics and government**
- Yokohama's mayoral race is being shaped by power harassment allegations against former mayor Takeharu Yamanaka, along with renewed debate over a possible casino development he opposes. While Takeharu Yamanaka promised to change his behavior, he has also rekindled the question of, and his opposition to, a potential casino development.
- Mie Prefecture passed what appears to be the country's first ordinance with penalties for customer harassment. According to the prefectural government, it is the first ordinance in Japan to impose penalties for customer harassment.
- The Cabinet approved a bill that would allow authorities to remotely access devices used by criminal groups, aimed at countering encrypted messaging. Authorities are seeking to counter encrypted messaging and prevent fraud, robbery and other offenses.
- Prime Minister Takaichi issued instructions in response to a suspected North Korean ballistic missile launch on October 12. October 12, 2026 Statements Instructions by the Prime Minister in Response to the Suspected Ballistic Missile Launch by North Korea (09:24), and the Prime Minister's office has also reported earlier launch responses on October 3.

**Economy**
- The Bank of Japan may hold off on a second straight rate increase. Bank of Japan officials are leaning against a rare back-to-back interest rate increase this month while still eyeing the possibility of another move as soon as December. The final policy decision at the Oct. 30 meeting could still change until the last minute, the people said.

**Cybersecurity**
- Japan has seen a wave of data breaches. Between late September and early October 2026, Japanese companies and public bodies disclosed one breach after another. TV Asahi counted more than 40 announcements in about a month. One notable case: IDC Frontier confirmed a third-party ransomware attack on its IDCF Cloud East Japan Region 1, starting at about 03:40 on 7 October 2026, affecting 495 companies and local governments. Note that this comes from a single third-party blog, so treat its details with some caution.

**Science and other news**
- The Prime Minister congratulated Kenso Soai, professor emeritus at Tokyo University of Science, on winning the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. October 7, 2026 Statements Comment by Prime Minister Takaichi on the Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026
- A Japan Times headline reported that nerves were rattled in Japan as an alert for a magnitude 9.9 quake was withdrawn minutes later. The snippet I found contained only the headline, so I can't confirm the details.
- Courts: the Nagoya District Court threw out a lawsuit filed on paper under rules requiring legal representatives to submit civil court documents online.

For the full stories, the Japan Times latest news page and the Prime Minister's Office news page are the best places to start.

2026年10月（今日は10月18日）の主な日本のニュースを、検索結果から整理しました。検索結果は各サイトの一覧や要約で、網羅的ではありません。

**政治・外交**
- 日米外相は、ICC（国際刑事裁判所）制裁をめぐって協議し、茂木外相が懸念を伝えました。日米外相、ＩＣＣ制裁巡り協議　茂木氏、懸念を伝達 (10/10 23:21)
- 尖閣諸島沖では、中国公船４隻が一時領海侵入　沖縄・尖閣沖 (10/10 19:25)と報じられています。
- 沖縄では、米海兵を強盗殺人容疑で逮捕（10月4日）という事件がありました。
- 国会では、衆院定数削減、自民に先送り論　消費減税への影響懸念 (10/03 07:10)など、税・選挙制度の議論が続いています。

**経済・企業**
- 10月1日には最低賃金が改定、全国平均は1177円に（10月1日）となりました。
- ビール税率が一本化、ビールは値下げ、発泡酒は値上げ（10月1日）も実施されました。
- 株式市場では、東京株、過去３番目の下げ幅　３３１８円安の６万４４２５円 (10/15 15:39)と大幅に下落しました。
- 企業の動きとして、赤沢経産相「ＡＩ競争優位を確保」　対米投資第３弾に半導体製造 (10/15 15:35)があったほか、サイゼリヤ、メニュー８割強を値上げ　２９日に、コスト上昇で (10/14 18:53)など値上げの動きも目立ちます。
- ビール大手4社については、ビール大手4社にカルテル疑惑、公正取引委員会が強制調査（10月7日）とされています。

**社会・事件・災害**
- 気象庁は、緊急地震速報の誤発表について当面の再発防止策を示しました。震源までの距離７００キロ超は対象外　気象庁、緊急地震速報誤発表で当面の再発防止策 (10/17 10:03)
- 茨城県では豚熱が確認され、茨城で豚熱、選択的殺処分へ　１１００頭、全国４例目 (10/16 20:36)とされています。
- 個人情報流出では、佐川急便はウェブサイトへの不正アクセスにより荷物の送り主と届け先の氏名、住所、電話番号などの個人情報が流出した可能性があると発表。
- 大手企業の横領事件では、【横領事件】ソフトバンク子会社の元常務を逮捕（10月1日）の報道もあります。
- 社会制度では、カスハラ対策を企業に義務付け、顧客による暴言など（10月1日）が始まりました。
- 献血について、厚生労働省が牛海綿状脳症の流行を理由に2000年から導入していた、欧州などに一定期間の滞在歴がある人の献血の制限を解除。

**その他**
- 科学・技術では、「うるう秒」実質廃止決定　国際度量衡総会 (10/15 23:17)が報じられました。
- 原子力関連では、茨城・常陸大宮で文献調査開始 核ごみ最終処分巡り、本州初―ＮＵＭＯ (10/15 15:09)とされています。
- 芸能・文化では、【89歳】伊東四朗が引退表明（10月1日）の報道がありました。

[Screenshot via X]","url":"https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10905287"},{"title":"Japan Meteorological Agency sent erroneous 9.9 quake alert, canceled quickly","url":"https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/world/japan-meteorological-agency-sent-erroneous-99-quake-alert-canceled-quickly/tldr"},{"title":"1st LD Writethru: Japan weather agency apologizes for mistakenly issuing \"9.9-magnitude\" earthquake warning","url":"https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2026/10/16/1st-ld-writethru-japan-weather-agency-apologizes-for-mistakenly-issuing-99-magnitude-earthquake-warning"},{"title":"Japan withdraws a seismic alert that mistakenly announced an earthquake of magnitude 9.9","url":"https://www.democrata.es/en/international/japan-withdraws-seismic-alert-that-mistakenly-announced-an-earthquake-of-magnitude-99/"}]

On Friday, October 16, 2026, the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) issued and then withdrew an erroneous early warning for a magnitude 9.9 quake. The real event was a magnitude 6.9 earthquake near Kamchatka, Russia.

- **The error:** The agency's system placed the quake in the Chishima (Kuril) Islands, off Hokkaido. It erroneously estimated that a magnitude-9.9 earthquake had occurred, and the JMA's earthquake and tsunami observation director said the magnitude figure came from a misjudged location. The incorrect figure was calculated when the Japanese agency mistook the location of the quake. The agency initially believed that the epicenter was in the Kuril Islands, rather than where it actually occurred, near the Kamchatka Peninsula.
- **The warning:** The warning, issued at 12:40 p.m., predicted that Hokkaido and the Tohoku region would be hit by shaking of up to 7, the highest level on Japan's seismic intensity scale. Alerts reached phones and the J-Alert system across eastern Japan, including Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Hokuriku, Tokai and the Izu Islands.
- **The withdrawal:** It retracted the warning at 12:48 p.m. The Tokaido Shinkansen briefly suspended service after a power cutoff, adding to the confusion.
- **The actual quake:** The earthquake was later identified as a magnitude 6.9 tremor that struck near the Kamchatka Peninsula at around 12:36 p.m. A maximum seismic intensity of 1 was recorded in Hakodate, Hokkaido, and no tsunami threat was reported.
- **Follow-up:** The agency apologized for the mistaken warning. It said it is investigating the cause of the erroneous projection. Ebita added that the error was not the result of a cyberattack, several of which have wreaked havoc in Japan in recent weeks.

Some reports differ on the timing and details. One says the JMA issued the warning at 12:36 p.m., while most others give 12:40 p.m. Reports also differ on the quake's depth, citing roughly 135 km, 140–160 km, and about 160 km. The investigation into the cause was still ongoing in the sources I found.

Alerts reached phones and the J-Alert system across eastern Japan, including Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Hokuriku, Tokai and the Izu Islands.
- **The withdrawal:** It retracted the warning at 12:48 p.m. The Tokaido Shinkansen briefly suspended service after a power cutoff, adding to the confusion.
- **The actual quake:** The earthquake was later identified as a magnitude 6.9 tremor that struck near the Kamchatka Peninsula at around 12:36 p.m. A maximum seismic intensity of 1 was recorded in Hakodate, Hokkaido, and no tsunami threat was reported.
- **Follow-up:** The agency apologized for the mistaken warning. It said it is investigating the cause of the erroneous projection. Ebita added that the error was not the result of a cyberattack, several of which have wreaked havoc in Japan in recent weeks.

Some reports differ on the timing and details. One says the JMA issued the warning at 12:36 p.m., while most others give 12:40 p.m. Reports also differ on the quake's depth, citing roughly 135 km, 140–160 km, and about 160 km. The investigation into the cause was still ongoing in the sources I found.
